nights.title: The Cactus Blossoms
nights.name: The Cactus Blossoms
nights.extract: The Cactus Blossoms is an American alternative country and indie folk band based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The band is composed of brothers Jack Torrey and Page Burkum with a touring act including Phillip Hicks (bass), Jake Hanson (guitar), and Jeremy Hanson (drums).

nights.title: Denise Julia
nights.name: Denise Julia
nights.extract: Julia Denise Lee, better known by her stage name Denise Julia, is a Filipino singer-songwriter, record producer, and model. She signed with Sony Music Philippines. In 2026, she moved to Empire Distribution, a record label in the United States. Numerous media outlets have recognized Julia as a leading figure in the new wave of Filipino R&B.
